chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Abdullah ibn al-Mughira, from Amr ibn Abi al-Miqdam who said:

I was in the presence of Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him), I and my father, so they brought a clay vessel containing water. So he (peace be upon him) drank while standing, then he handed it to my father, and he drank from it while standing. Then he handed it to me, so I drank from it while standing.

key_terms.خَزَف: Clay or earthenware; refers to a ceramic/pottery vessel
key_terms.قَائِم: Standing (upright); the key term indicating the posture of drinking
key_terms.قَدَح: A cup or vessel, typically a drinking vessel
key_terms.نَاوَلَ: To hand/pass something to someone; the act of offering the vessel

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to drink water while standing according to Imam al-Baqir?
ai.summary: This hadith records a witnessed practice of Imam al-Baqir (peace be upon him) in which he drank water from an earthenware vessel while standing, and passed it to the narrator's father and the narrator himself, all of whom also drank while standing. This narration appears in the chapter on drinking water while standing, serving as a practical precedent demonstrating the permissibility — and perhaps recommendability — of drinking in that posture. The act of the Imam drinking first and then passing the vessel to companions reflects both his hospitality and his role as a living model of Islamic conduct.

en.hubeali: A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Abu Abdullah, from his father, from his grandfather, from Abdullah Bin Al Mugheira, from Amro Bin Abu Al Miqdam who said,

‘I was in the presence of Abu Ja’far<sup>asws</sup>, I and my father, so they came to us with a clay vessel in which was water. So he<sup>asws</sup> drank standing, then gave it to my father. So he drank from it, and he was standing. Then he gave it to me, so I drank from it, and I was standing’.
en.sarwar: 5. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn abu ‘Abd Allah from his father from his grandfather from ‘Abd Allah ibn al- Mughirah from ‘Amr ibn abu al-Miqdam who has said the following: “

Once my father and I were with abu Ja’far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, when a bowl made of pottery with water was brought. He (the Imam) drank standing. He then gave it to my father who also drank standing and gave it to me and I also drank standing.’”
